rules.text:
Heightened Spell
Cost: 2 Sorcery Points
When you cast a spell that forces a creature to make
a saving throw, you can spend 2 Sorcery Points to
give one target of the spell Disadvantage on saves
against the spell.

authored_operations.trigger: Cast spell forcing creature to save
effects: Choose one target; Disadvantage on saves against that spell, including later saves
